item.title: Failed 'torturous' execution attempt on Christa Pike reignites death penalty debate
item.description: The botched execution in Tennessee of Christa Pike, who survived despite being subject to two doses of lethal injection on Wednesday, has reignited furious debate about the death penalty in the U.S.

item.title: Car crimes in San Francisco have dropped. The city says Flock cameras have helped

item.title: Failed execution attempts are not uncommon in the U.S.
item.description: The failed execution attempt of a woman in Tennessee on Wednesday wasn't the first time this has happened. The state's execution protocols have been under scrutiny for years.
